final.name: Assumption–reality alignment
final.audit_justification: Explicitly redesigning a method around a named mismatch between assumptions and the deployment setting is substantive methodological rigor.

final.name: Artifact-release advertising: code URLs, project pages, videos
final.audit_justification: The rubric scores only the presence and elaborateness of release advertising language, not the substance of any released artifact, and such advertising habits track well-resourced, engineering-mature teams who also tend to produce stronger work.
final.upstream_parent: institutional release capacity and lab open-source policy (engineering support, legal clearance, hosting)

final.name: Uncertainty-aware decision rule
final.audit_justification: Explicitly representing and acting on uncertainty in a decision rule is a substantive methodological property, not a surface marker.

final.name: Trend-currentness markers
final.audit_justification: Currentness language is a temporal fashion marker independent of the truth of the claims, though it can co-occur with groups genuinely working at the frontier.

final.name: Importance-of-problem preamble before any technical content
final.audit_justification: This scores only how much rhetorical throat-clearing precedes technical content, explicitly not whether the importance claim is accurate, and the habit has no clear link to a quality-producing upstream cause.

final.name: Branded method acronym or typographic coinage
final.audit_justification: Scores only the presence of a branded/typographic method name, explicitly not whether the name fits or the method works, and acronym-coining is a near-universal community convention unlinked to a resource or skill differential.
final.upstream_parent: institutional PR / lab branding practice and professional writing support

final.name: Interpretability with operational consequence
final.audit_justification: Whether an interpretable structure is put to operational use (control, diagnosis, improvement) is a substantive methodological contribution.

final.name: Foregrounds a counterintuitive empirical result
final.audit_justification: Whether the central finding genuinely contradicts a reasonable prior expectation is a property of the result's content, not just its presentation.

final.name: Constraint-matched problem formulation
final.audit_justification: Explicit correspondence between design choices and named task constraints is substantive methodological fit.

final.name: Stress-tested validity
final.audit_justification: Probing robustness under shift, perturbation, or varied tasks and identifying failure boundaries is substantive evaluation rigor.

final.name: Mechanistic explanation for an observed phenomenon
final.audit_justification: Proposing and testing a specific causal hypothesis for an observed effect is substantive scientific reasoning beyond reporting a metric change.

final.name: Abstract length / verbosity
final.audit_justification: Raw sentence/word count is scored explicitly independent of whether the length is appropriate or the underlying paper is good, though greater length can also reflect a genuinely more thorough report of methods and caveats.

final.name: Trend-term concentration
final.audit_justification: Counts frequency of fashionable terminology explicitly independent of whether the research is good, though concentration of frontier terms can coincide with groups doing genuinely cutting-edge work.

final.name: Formalism density
final.audit_justification: Counts amount of formal notation explicitly independent of correctness or importance, though higher formalism density often comes from a theory-oriented tradition that also produces rigorous, provable results.

final.name: Memorable title framing
final.audit_justification: Rates only the title's stylistic memorability, explicitly not whether the research is good, and catchy-title habits are a widespread convention not clearly tied to a quality-producing cause.

final.name: Concrete, vivid endpoint achievement stated in plain language
final.audit_justification: Rewards plain-language vividness of a stated achievement over numeric deltas, which is a framing choice rather than a property of the underlying evidence, though genuinely landmark results are also more naturally described in vivid terms.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores how an achievement is phrased -- vivid, plain-language, easily-visualized milestone versus abstract numeric delta -- so two abstracts reporting the identical result would diverge purely on rhetorical framing, which is a writing-style channel rather than evidence about the research. It is mixed because genuinely landmark results are more naturally describable as memorable milestones, so the upstream cause can also produce real quality.

final.name: Construct validity of metric or benchmark
final.audit_justification: Independently validating an operational definition against its intended construct, with stated limitations, is substantive methodological rigor.

final.name: Quantified result detail
final.audit_justification: Presenting exact margins, error values, and specific quantitative detail is evidence of rigorous, verifiable empirical reporting rather than a mere style marker.
final.arbiter_reason: Reporting exact margins, error values, and specific quantitative detail is a property of the underlying empirical evidence and its verifiability, not a surface fingerprint: it exposes claims to checking and is standard evidence-reporting craft, which Track A explicitly covers. The 'not whether results are good' clause shifts it from magnitude to rigor of reporting, which remains substantive rather than incidental.

final.name: Scope conditions and assumptions volunteered unprompted
final.audit_justification: Volunteering explicit scope, assumptions, or cost boundaries unprompted is substantive scientific candor about where the result holds.

final.name: Theorem-to-design alignment
final.audit_justification: Formal guarantees that directly justify the construction under clearly stated assumptions is substantive theoretical grounding for the method.

final.name: Representation matched to task geometry
final.audit_justification: Choosing a representation because its structure matches the task's symmetries or geometry is substantive methodological justification.

final.name: Evaluation that isolates the contribution
final.audit_justification: Isolating the contribution from alternative explanations via ablations or targeted comparisons is substantive evaluation design.

final.name: Transferable integration with existing systems
final.audit_justification: Modular compatibility that preserves or expands an existing system's useful properties is a substantive engineering and design merit.

final.name: Formal or provable guarantee accompanying the method
final.audit_justification: A stated formal guarantee or proof central to the contribution, rather than only an empirical average, is substantive theoretical rigor.

final.name: Template-structure conformity
final.audit_justification: Rates conformity to a conventional rhetorical sequence explicitly independent of whether the research is good, though full template coverage can also reflect a more complete, careful write-up.
